summary: This is a Form 6-K filed by Banco Santander-Chile reporting a material fact: the placement of dematerialized bearer bonds (Series BF, ticker BSTDBF0325) in the local Chilean market, totaling Ch$25,000,000,000 (approx. USD 26 million) maturing September 1, 2031, with an average placement rate of 6.10%. The issuance uses a previously registered line of credit with the CMF. This is a routine debt offering, not a special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring. No special-situation categories apply.
